subject: VOLCANIC ACTIVITY AT THE MONTSERRAT SOUFRIERE HILLS VOLCANO
text:
VOLCANIC ACTIVITY AT THE MONTSERRAT SOUFRIERE HILLS VOLCANO
POSES SIGNIFICANT HAZARDS TO SHIPPING WITHIN TWO MILES OF
THE SOUTHERN AND WESTERN COASTS OF MONTSERRAT DUE TO THE
POTENTIAL THREAT OF THE SURGES GENERATED BY PYROCLASTIC FLOWS
FROM THE VOLCANO.

subject: CHART 11494 (6TH ED).
text:
CHART 11494 (6TH ED).
1. POSITIONS OBTAINED FROM SATELLITE NAVIGATION AND INERTIAL
   SYSTEMS REFERRED TO THE WORLD GEODETIC SYSTEM 1984 (WGS-84)
   CANNOT BE PLOTTED DIRECTLY ON THIS CHART (11494, 6TH ED).
2. DUE TO THE LARGE SCALE OF CHART 11494, 6TH ED, AND THE CLOSE
   PROXIMITY OF LAND, RECOMMEND RELIANCE ON PILOTING SKILLS
   USING VISUAL, RADAR, AND RELATIVE BEARINGS FOR POSITIONING.
3. THE 7TH ED OF CHART 11494, WHICH IS EXPECTED TO BE RELEASED
   BY MID JULY 1998, WILL IMPROVE THE CHART SO THAT POSITIONS
   DERIVED FROM SATELLITE NAVIGATION AND INERTIAL SYSTEMS CAN BE
   DIRECTLY PLOTTED ONTO THE CHART.
4. ON CHART 11494, 6TH ED, DELETE THE DATUM NOTE WHICH READS:
   ``POSITIONS OBTAINED FROM SATELLITE NAVIGATION SYSTEMS REFERRED
   TO THE WORLD GEODETIC SYSTEM 1984 (WGS) CAN BE PLOTTED DIRECTLY
   ON THIS CHART.''
5. USE OF THE 5TH ED OF CHART 11494 IS NOT RECOMMENDED.

subject: 1. THE INTERNATIONAL ICE PATROL BROADCAST SERVICES FOR THE 1998
text:
1. THE INTERNATIONAL ICE PATROL BROADCAST SERVICES FOR THE 1998
   SEASON WILL TERMINATE 311200Z JUL.
2. AFTER 31 JUL, VESSELS ARE REQUESTED TO CONTINUE TO SEND REPORTS
   OF ICE SIGHTINGS SOUTH OF 52-00N TO COMINTICEPAT GROTON CT. ALL
   OTHER ICE SIGHTINGS AND REQUESTS FOR ICE INFORMATION SHOULD BE
   ADDRESSED FOR ACTION TO NIMA NAVSAFETY BETHESDA MD, OR ICE CENTRAL
   OTTAWA ON CAN, WITH INFO COPY TO COMINTICEPAT GROTON CT, AND
   NAVLANTMETOCCEN NORFOLK VA.
3. REPORTS OF ICE SIGHTINGS ARE DESIRED IN PLAIN LANGUAGE FORM.
4. MARINERS ARE STILL ADVISED TO USE EXTREME CAUTION WHEN
   NAVIGATING NEAR THE GRAND BANKS.
5. CANCEL NAVAREA IV 52/98.
